JOIN OUR TEAM

Bring your skills to FI.

We welcome applications for the roles below. Tell us about your experience and availability. We will discuss the scope, location and working arrangements with you before any role is agreed.

QUALITY & CARE

Warehouse quality inspector

Check incoming products against order specifications, document their condition and flag issues before customer dispatch.

A careful eye, clear inspection records and practical product knowledge.

Apply for warehouse inspection ↗

STORIES & GROWTH

Marketing & content coordinator

Share our products, makers and inspection process through useful content, campaigns and genuine customer stories.

Clear writing, visual storytelling and thoughtful campaign planning.

Apply for marketing ↗

GLOBAL MAKERS

Supplier sourcing coordinator

Find manufacturers, confirm product specifications and source details, and coordinate supplier communication.

Research skills, attention to detail and confidence working across cultures.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

Customer & order support

Help buyers with product questions, order updates, inspection progress, delivery and after-sales support.

Patient communication, organised follow-through and a customer-first approach.

A CONVERSATION WITH FI

Let’s hear from you.

For buyers
Ask about a product, its specifications, warehouse inspection or your order. Include a product name or order reference when you have one.

For suppliers
Introduce your company, country of manufacture and product range. A website or catalogue link helps us understand your work.

For applicants
Choose a position and tell us what you would bring to FI. A CV or portfolio link is welcome. Applications go privately to our team for review; submitting one does not create an account or confirm a role.

One of the founders will reply, usually within 48 hours. Supplier introductions are reviewed before products can join our collection.
